graph.decoder: 6 pre-norm Transformer blocks, 512 hidden, 8 heads, 2048 feed-forward
graph.encoder: conv2d6 plus 18 pre-norm Transformer blocks, 512 hidden, 8 heads, 2048 feed-forward
graph.frontend: 16 kHz, 512-point centered Hann STFT, 128-sample hop, 80-bin checkpoint-stored librosa Slaney log-mel, global MVN
graph.objective: 0.3 CTC plus 0.7 label-smoothed autoregressive sequence loss

parity.checkpoint_inventory: Obtained from the legacy pickle metadata and persistent storage descriptors via bounded HTTP ranges; no tensor payload was downloaded.
parity.warning: Published WER includes the exact released language model and decoding recipe. VoiceHub does not claim those numbers for modified weights, decoding settings, or data.

supported: The exact ESPnet 0.8.0 LibriSpeech Transformer e18 graph
VoiceHub-native artifacts exported from that graph
Explicit custom configurations for new training runs
unsupported: Conformer, Branchformer, transducer, RNN, streaming, and arbitrary ESPnet YAML graphs
The dead kan-bayashi Hugging Face identifier as a download source

training.augmentation: published bicubic time warp plus two frequency and two time masks
supported_inputs: precomputed log-mel features plus token labels
